title: Echinoderms

conceptScope.en: COL26.8 routes accepted living echinoderm names as nomenclatural browse coverage. Field-linked Echinodermata and Echinoidea profiles separate articulated Cambrian faunas and Ordovician total-group plates from contested older stereom and model-dependent crown ages. The highlighted samples do not establish a global origin, one ancestral ecology or direct ancestry, and remaining legacy ranges stay explicitly provisional.
conceptScope.zh: COL26.8 把现生棘皮动物接受名作为命名浏览层路由。逐字段棘皮动物门与海胆纲档案把寒武纪关节相连动物群和奥陶纪总群骨板，与更早但有争议的立体网骨片及依赖模型的冠群年代严格分开。重点样本不确定全球起源、单一祖先生态或直系祖先，其余旧版延限继续明确标为暂定。

limitations: Package dossiers expose the current curated evidence boundary; unavailable fields are explicit and are not inferred.
